name: 看电影·背影视角
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Edit the attached movie-date cover featuring Lulu (噜噜) and Lumei (噜妹). Change the camera angle to a BACK VIEW and include a LARGE CINEMA SCREEN in front of them. This is the user's explicit requested improvement.
Preserve the exact recognizable character models and the soft rounded matte 3D animation style from the input. Lulu is the larger golden-yellow capybara wearing orange shorts and the small tangerine with a short green stalk on top of his head. Lumei is the slightly smaller golden-yellow capybara wearing her soft pink dress and distinctive ivory ruffled bonnet, topped by the little tangerine with two green leaves and an ivory ring. The viewer sees the backs of their rounded heads, ears, shoulders and head ornaments. Do not turn their faces toward the camera. If any tiny profile is visible, both muzzles remain completely smooth with NO nostrils, holes, nose dots or separate nose.
Composition: one polished square 1:1 product-cover image. Place the two characters close together in adjoining plush dusty-coral theater seats in the lower half of the frame, viewed from directly behind and slightly above. Lumei gently rests her head against Lulu's shoulder; their heads touch. The backs of the seats remain relatively low so the character silhouettes and pink shoulders are visible. Head ornaments entirely in frame. A small popcorn bucket may be glimpsed beside them at an armrest, but it is secondary.
A large luminous wide rectangular cinema screen dominates the upper half of the image, occupying about 85% of the frame width, clearly separate from the walls with a softly rounded dark frame. Both characters face this screen. The screen shows a beautiful simple animated sunset landscape with peach clouds, a lavender lake and softly rounded distant mountains, with no people, words or titles. Make it obviously a cinema interior with restrained dark plum-blue walls, a subtle dark-red curtain on each side, one or two faint rows of seats below the screen and warm low aisle lights. Keep the theater uncluttered; no extra people.
Lighting and emotion: the large screen bathes the couple in gentle peach/lavender rim light, with enough soft warm ambient fill to keep their golden color, the orange ornaments and pink clothes clearly visible. Cozy, sweet, cute, calm and happy, like sharing a private little world at the movies. Not gloomy, no harsh contrast, no photorealistic people or texture noise.
The cinema screen and the affectionate couple seen from behind are the two key readable shapes, with convincing common perspective. Avoid front-facing character portraits, televisions, tiny screens, collage panels, watermarks, letters and speech bubbles. Output one finished square illustration.
